wiki.title: Minnie Gonzalez
wiki.extract: Minnie Gonzalez (born August 4, 1950) is an American politician serving as a member of the Connecticut House of Representatives since 1997, the 3rd district, comprising parts of Hartford. A member of the Democratic Party, She serves on the Appropriations, Public Safety, Legislative Management and Housing Committees, and is the president of Connecticut's Puerto Rican and Latino Caucus.
